CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE V SRISHANANDA  ORAL ORDER
A memo is filed by learned counsel for the appellant for withdrawal.

The memo reads as under:
"The parties in the above appeal have settled their dispute in respect to entitlement of the compensation amount to the respondent before the Lokadalath Court, Davangare on 19.04.2024 and - 11 - The Commissioner vs Smt. Kotramma on 12 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/117202280/
8 NC: 2024:KHC:34121 AND 5 OTHERS accordingly the respondents have received the compensation amount from the appellant authority.
Hence, in view of the above this Hon'ble Court be pleased to permit the appellant to withdraw the above appeal by ordering for refund of the Court fee paid in the above appeal."
2. In view of the memo, all these appeals are dismissed as settled in Lok Adalath before the District Court, Davangere.
3. As such the appellants are entitled to refund of permissible Court fee.
Sd/-
